name: Valid Myrkul
source: Despite being Vampire from Noble Family and living for a long time, she doesn't like sucking blood from human and is ignorant when it comes to sex. She promises to return the protagonist to human if he becomes her servant and helps her to obtain the power of strongest vampire which she is looking for. She is extremely arrogant and has twisted personality. However, there is a reason for her to seek power.
